notes: This is ONE 720x1280 SHOT cropped from a much larger Wang Meng hanging scroll, not the whole scroll. Plan depth planes for THIS view only: the trestle bridge and its near ledge, the figures on it, the pine crossing the frame, the rocks in the stream, the receding river, the cliff wall behind. Use as many planes as this view actually contains and no more - do not pad to a target count. Space is encoded by overlap, contour and unpainted silk, not by perspective.
note: x,y normalised 0..1. depth 0 = farthest. window in native px; a mask cannot exceed it.
